arStrings.szText: {c_important}Brandish{/c} unleashes {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} additional arcs that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_PROJ_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage and apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.
While {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u},{/c} {c_important}Brandish{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_PROJ_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage and travels {c_number}[{SF_9} * 100|%|]{/c} faster.
